items.title: David Torkanowsky interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, September 26, 2019
items.q: Shannon Powell, a great New Orleans drummer, last of his kind, Louis Bellson level, won Down Beat awards best drummer of the year when he was playing with Harry Connick, Jr. He’s from the Sixth Ward.

ctx.x: Okay. You don’t take it kindly when people or writers or something say yeah New Orleans is back to where it was.

Oh well that’s interesting you should say that because somebody asked me to — there’s a French bread company in New Orleans called Leidenheimer’s. French bread is the bread that po’ boys are made out of. And so it’s a real old family art. And he said, “Hey a friend of mine, journalist, wants to write a story about how New Orleans came back.” And I wrote this scathing blistering letter about are you kidding me? You know Katrina was a cultural cataclysm that exploded decades of aural, like A-U-R-A-L and oral,…
You were talking about people assuming or saying that it’s back to where it was.
